mapper.sql: c.id,c.tenant_id AS tenantId,c.provider,c.base_url AS baseUrl,c.api_key_cipher AS apiKeyCipher,c.model,c.timeout_seconds AS timeoutSeconds,c.enabled,c.connection_status AS connectionStatus,c.last_error_masked AS lastErrorMasked,c.last_connected_at AS lastConnectedAt,c.created_at AS createdAt,c.updated_at AS updatedAt,c.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_ai_provider_config c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
SELECT FROM crm_ai_provider_config c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_ai_provider_config c SET c.provider=#{e.provider},c.base_url=#{e.baseUrl},c.api_key_cipher=#{e.apiKeyCipher},c.model=#{e.model},c.timeout_seconds=#{e.timeoutSeconds},c.enabled=#{e.enabled},c.connection_status='UNVERIFIED',c.last_error_masked=NULL,c.last_connected_at=NULL,c.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),c.version=c.version+1 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{id} AND c.version=#{version}

UPDATE crm_ai_provider_config c SET c.connection_status=#{status},c.last_error_masked=#{errorMasked},c.last_connected_at=#{connectedAt},c.updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),c.version=c.version+1 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{id} AND c.version=#{version}
